title: About Us
name: Celia Liang
paragraphs: Hi, I'm Celia! I'm a senior at New York University pursuing a B.A. in Computer Science, with an expected graduation date of May 2027. My coursework includes Software Engineering, Web Design, Applied Internet Technology, and Big Data.

I enjoy frontend development and building personal websites with HTML, CSS, and JavaScript. I built and maintain my personal blog at becomingcelia.com. My interest in web design started in eighth grade, when an art class inspired me to create a design portfolio blog.

My programming background includes Python, JavaScript, Java, C, HTML, and CSS. I also work with tools such as Git, VS Code, Figma, and Blender. I want to keep developing my software engineering skills and grow as a developer.

Outside of programming, I have three cats and two turtles at home. I love exploring classical music, especially string instruments and modern piano pieces. I'm a native Chinese speaker and am fluent in English.
